answer: Give each newcomer one sparrow courier drone, keyed to its public key, carrying a single ember capsule through nine karst spires. A spire's gate opens only once the holder files the ember's heat reading from the last spire, so the flight chains and no reading fits a second drone. A copied heat log fails: each ember cools along its own curve, and a reheated capsule never matches fresh ash. One flight costs a $420 drone plus 30 flight-hours; 5,000 phantoms demand 5,000 drones: $2.1 million and 150,000 flight-hours. One drone flies one route; a spent ember never burns twice.
